84cdc0.title: AREA 5 NEWS — summary of results
84cdc0.content:
## AREA 5 (News module) results ### CONFIRMED (filed as vuln report) - **Stored XSS via news TITLE -> JSON-LD `headline` break-out** (helpers/seo_helper.php:415, reached from views/public/berita-detail.php). `json_encode(..., JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES|JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE)` does NOT hex-escape `<`/`>`; title is stored raw (not sanitized by `sanitizeNewsContent`, which is content-only). Title ``, `
`, `/`-separated `

`, tab/newline-separated handlers, `style=expression()`. Script-only payloads are dropped and the whole content rejected if empty. Event-handler regex is solid. - SQLi: slug parsed by strict `/-(\d+)$/` + `(int)` cast; all queries prepared with bound params. No error/time-based/UNION/stacked signal (all 404, no delay). - CSRF: missing/empty/wrong token -> 419; cross-session token -> 401 (session-id-bound AEAD tokens). Replay of a valid same-session token works (expected, per-session token). - AuthZ: mahasiswa/dosen POST /action/news -> 403; GET /admin/news/tambah -> redirected to their own pages. `news-admin.php` lists only own articles (AdminNews($id_admin)). - Draft reachability: N/A — NEWS table has no status/draft/published column; all rows immediately public. - Open redirect / SSRF: image field is upload-only (server never fetches URLs); canonical redirect + `app_page_url` build relative URLs via `http_build_query` (no CRLF/host injection). No SSRF. ### OBSERVATION (not filed / defense-in-depth) - `NewsController::update()`/`delete()` and request/handler-news.php + edit-berita.php do NOT verify the requesting admin owns the article (no `penulis_id` check). Exploitation is gated by session-bound AEAD id-tokens (`sid`=sha256(session_id)) minted only for the admin's own rows, so cross-admin edit is not directly reachable. Hardening gap (CWE-639), not a confirmed exploit.
